topic: Discrete Convolutions: From Image Blurring to Signal Processing

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The 'Moving Window' Concept
lecture_lines: Convolution is a sliding window transformation.
The kernel is a small mask.
It scans across the input grid.
animations: Draw a moving rectangle [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/window.svg] over a stationary grid [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].
Highlight the grid elements [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] covered by the rectangle.
Show the sum of products inside the window [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/window.svg].

animations: Display vector A and vector B.
Perform a sliding dot product between A and B using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/kernel.svg] as the convolution kernel.

sections.title: Prerequisite Alignment: Why we use Convolutions
lecture_lines: Inputs affect the current system state.
